verses.1: I have made a covenant with my eyes; what will they build upon the wall?
verses.2: And what is the share of God from above, and the territory of Sheba from the mountains?
verses.3: It is not right to do such things, and it should be avoided by those who are involved in such activities.
verses.4: He will surely see my ways, and every step I take will be recorded.
verses.5: If I went with Shua, then my feet will be deceived by deception.
verses.6: He will weigh me with justice in His ears, and God will know my true nature.
verses.7: If you take my path, then after that, my eyes will go elsewhere. But in my heart, I remain steadfast.
verses.8: He will sow, and others will eat; his descendants will be prosperous.
verses.9: If my heart is attached to a woman, and to the door of my enemy’s house, then I will enter.
verses.10: She will be placed in another place, and others will fall upon her.
verses.11: For she was a time of joy, and he was a time of sorrow.
verses.12: For fire will burn until it is destroyed; and in every new creation, it will be renewed again.
verses.13: If my servant is judged unjustly, and my truth is wronged among them, then I will stand against them.
verses.14: And what shall I do when He rises again, and when He will bring about His punishment?
verses.15: He did not create me in the beginning; he created me and then placed me in the womb of a woman.
verses.16: If I can avoid being trapped in poverty and the eyes of those who are blind, then I will be able to eat.
verses.17: And I eat alone, and I do not eat with others from my own food.
verses.18: For from my youth, I was raised by a father; and from my childhood, my mother nurtured me.
verses.19: If I see someone who has been killed without being buried, and there’s no one to bury them.
verses.20: If their clothes do not bless me, and if their feet are covered with dirt, then they will be destroyed.
verses.21: If my hands are raised to the heavens, then I will see in that gate my Savior.
verses.22: Like a bird from its nest, it will fly away; and like a plant from its soil, it will be pulled out.
verses.23: For fear of him, I cannot go near him at all.
verses.24: If I have laid gold as a foundation, then I said it with certainty.
verses.25: If I rejoice, it’s because my army is strong, and my hands are mighty.
verses.26: If I see light, then Yahel and Yarach will also be able to walk.
verses.27: And she sealed my heart with her kisses, and she wiped my hands on my face.
verses.28: It’s also a verbal expression of fear, as if I were to be destroyed by God from above.
verses.29: If I am hated by those who despise me, and if I am treated with contempt, then it’s as if they have found something bad about me.
verses.30: And I did not give in to sin. I waited to be asked to do so with all my heart.
verses.31: If they do not say, “My tent belongs to Me; who can give it away from its owner?” then we will not be disturbed.
verses.32: Outside, I won’t open my doors for anyone to enter.
verses.33: If I were a wicked man, then I would be buried in the depths of hell.
verses.34: For the earth is full of thorns; it’s a difficult place to walk on. No human can enter there.
verses.35: Who will listen to me? Who will answer my prayers? And who will record the names of those who are my enemies?
verses.36: If not on my own, then let me be carried away by them. Let them cover me with their garments.
verses.37: I will tell you how many steps we have taken, just as I would tell you when we approach.
verses.38: If my land cries out in pain, and they all join together to weep over it.
verses.39: If I were to eat without money, and with my soul in her hands, I would be destroyed.
verses.40: Under the loom, a thread is woven; beneath the roof, a woman speaks words of wisdom.
